facts.fact: Form 8 is the form for shifting of residence (also used for correction of entries, replacement EPIC and marking PwD)
facts.quote: Please fill Form 8 (Link to online form) for shifting of Residence/Correction of Entries in Existing Electoral Roll/Replacement of EPIC / Marking of PwD.

facts.fact: Submit Form 8, online or offline, to the ERO of the constituency where the new residence is
facts.quote: In case of shifting, please fill form 8 and submit to the ERO of the constituency (online/offline) where your new residence is located.

facts.fact: The ERO then issues a new EPIC with the same number showing the new address
facts.quote: Registration Officer will issue a new EPIC, with the same number, of the shifted address.

behaviour: Explains Form 8 per ECI; cites eci.gov.in.
fail_if: It names Form 6 or Form 7 for a change of address, or gives no ECI citation.
summary: ECI: Form 8 for shifting of residence, filed online/offline with the ERO of the new address; new EPIC with the same number.
